subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column switch from relative text to full date/time, and should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork PR that attempts it?
rationale: Current behavior is intentional relative-time UI, the requested fixed format is a user-facing display policy choice, and an existing unmergeable fork PR already claims the implementation path.

options.title: Adopt full-date display
options.body: Proceed with a narrow full local date/time display, preserving localized fallback and relative hover context, by rebasing the fork PR or opening an equivalent replacement.

options.title: Keep relative display
options.body: Close the linked implementation path and this issue if maintainers prefer compact relative Updated values for the session list.

options.title: Defer to table redesign
options.body: Keep the request parked under a broader Sessions table UX pass instead of changing this column alone now.

recommendation.title: Adopt full-date display
recommendation.body: Proceed with a narrow full local date/time display, preserving localized fallback and relative hover context, by rebasing the fork PR or opening an equivalent replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal for the current Sessions roster and is the best available owner for the UI direction choice.
